# pdf-layout-extract

> Reading-order text from positioned PDF words: recursive XY-cut for columns, three-column-plus aligned regions as tables, hyphen joins, input shaped like pdfplumber words Python package `trysac-pdf-layout-extract`, import name `pdf_layout_extract`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
